heuristic: Manhattan distance to closest remaining uncollected gold piece: min(|r - gr| + |c - gc|)

movement_rules.support: A cell (r, c) is supported if current cell is '#' or '-', or cell below (r+1, c) is solid ('B', 'b') or '#', or r == ROWS-1 (bottom screen boundary).

transitions.not_supported: Can only fall straight down (r+1, c) into any non-solid cell.
transitions.supported: Can move left (r, c-1) and right (r, c+1) into any non-solid cell.
transitions.on_ladder: Can move up (r-1, c) and down (r+1, c) into any non-solid cell (includes stepping up out of ladder top).
transitions.on_rope: Can drop down (r+1, c) into any non-solid cell.
transitions.above_ladder: Standing directly above a ladder cell, can step down (r+1, c) into '#'.

movement_rules.digging: Standing on a supported cell (r, c), player can dig diagonally down-left (r+1, c-1) or down-right (r+1, c+1) if target is 'b' and adjacent cell (r, c-1) or (r, c+1) is clear. Monotone fixpoint expands opened cells until saturation.
movement_rules.enemies: Treated as open air in pathfinding pursuant to Sorochan et al. (FDG 2021) to prevent instant-death false negatives.
